anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De Oratione exists (only copyrighted Greer/O'Meara/Oulton-Chadwick); nothing to compare against. Sense checked against the Greek and cited Scripture wording.

apparatus: Four topoi: doxology, thanksgiving, confession, petition (cf. 1 Tim 2:1).
Ps 103; 2 Sam 7; Ps 38-39; Ps 27:3 examples quoted.
Doxological close 'to whom be glory unto the ages.'

choices.why: topoi = topics-seats; each prayer-kind is a place to stand and speak from — rhetorical term kept.
Become embittered over sins: confession's affect between thanksgiving and petition.

pass_a_gloss: Four scattered topoi bodied into one prayer: doxology (through Christ in Spirit) first, common thanksgivings, embittered confession with healing asked, request for great heavenly things own and general — all resting in doxology. Each grounded in a psalm/historical example.
